Several vendors provide products and solutions across several mobile network domains. 
Vendors that operate in more than one domain are counted for each domain where we 
have identified an active partnership.  
Overall, as of June 2025, the US and the UK had 44 active vendor partnerships across the 
four mobile network domains; Japan had 30, China and India 23, South Korea 21, Canada 
19, and Australia 17. The ecosystem of vendors remains largely the same as in 2024, but a 
few new active vendors were identified in Australia, the US, the UK, and Canada. 
Figure 4: Active vendors in the mobile ecosystem, by domain and by country 
 
 Source: Omdia 
Omdia conducted a similar assessment in the same countries for three fixed network 
domains: copper and fiber access, switching and routing, and optical networking. As in 
mobile domains, in fixed domains there were, unsurprisingly, more active vendors in the 
larger markets (the US, China, India, and Japan) than in the smaller markets.
